scope: Root-owned inactive Cargo Mach-O executable artifacts only, preserved losslessly before unlink. No rawlogs/source/models/nativearchives/rlibs/other cache removed. No new test/qualification. No Rust rlib copy.
restore_policy: Restore into a fresh directory, set recorded executable mode; do not silently overwrite Cargo/current source artifacts. Original gzip decompressed into an actual tempfile and read back for size/SHA verification.
